fullGenerationPromptEnglish:
Create ONE finished square 1:1 three-scene watercolor narrative for an adult Persian book. The story concerns a colleague who complains that nobody contributes in a meeting, recognizes the own habit of interrupting, and creates a better meeting by listening.

LAYOUT
Two equal upper scenes read RIGHT first, LEFT second, and one wide lower outcome scene. Clean white paper gaps, soft irregular painted edges and generous white outer margins. This is an ordinary adult workplace, never a kindergarten or toy-block activity.

CAST AND ROOM
Exactly three medium adult neutral colored colleagues:
PINK is the main character, with a few fine short upper-outer eyelashes on the same small dark oval eye design; no feminine chest, waist, hips or buttocks.
GREEN is a colleague with no eyelashes.
BLUE is another colleague with no eyelashes.
Plain colored bodies, no special clothes, fixed colors and identity across scenes.
A restrained bright meeting room with a wooden rectangular table, three sensible dark grey upholstered chairs, a window on the left with soft greenery outside, a pale wall with a simple project board, and a wooden door on the right. Table has coherent supports/legs and enough space beneath it for every colleague's natural seated legs and ALL SIX FEET to be fully visible. One modest plant near the window is enough. Papers and yellow pencils on the table; a plain closed grey notebook near green. Project papers and board use nonverbal diagrams, faint schematic strokes, pie/bar shapes and small sticky-note blocks, never extra readable words or English.

UPPER RIGHT: THE OWN INTERRUPTING HABIT
Three colleagues sit around the table: green on the left, pink in the middle, blue on the right. Pink dominates the conversation with an irritated talking mouth, tense brows, one hand raised as an interrupting STOP PALM toward green and the other raised with pointing index. Pink looks at the colleagues and speaks in a bubble whose tail clearly points to pink:
"چرا کسی نظر نمیده؟"
Green's mouth has begun to open and green has raised a hand to offer a contribution, but pink is visibly taking the floor again. Blue holds a paper and pencil, discouraged, shoulders slightly lowered. This is a clear gentle human irony: pink's conduct is helping to cause the silence being criticized. All bodies, chairs, seated legs and six feet fit inside the upper scene with white breathing room.

UPPER LEFT: PAUSING AND RECOGNIZING
Same room and same seating positions. Green gently raises a hand and asks to speak. One short bubble with its tail clearly leading to GREEN reads exactly:
"اجازه می‌دی بگم؟"
Pink has STOPPED talking. Mouth is closed/downturned slightly, brows reflective, one hand resting lightly near the own mouth as a thoughtful pause and the other relaxed on the table. Do not add a literal chin or nose. Blue remains attentive with paper and pencil, awaiting the turn.
The change in pink's gesture and expression shows accepting a difficult truth about the own behavior, without shaming or an exaggerated punishment. Include complete chairs, all natural seated legs and six feet, no cropping beneath the tabletop.

LOWER WIDE: GIVING THE FLOOR AND LISTENING
A slightly wider closer frontal arrangement: pink is toward the left, green in the middle, blue toward the right. They are the same three colleagues in the same short continuous meeting. Pink is now relaxed, offers the floor with an open welcoming hand, and uses the other hand to WRITE NOTES on a pad with a yellow pencil while listening. A short speech bubble clearly belongs to PINK:
"نوبت توئه."
Green is speaking with a warm engaged face, holding up a white project sheet showing a SIMPLE NONVERBAL FLOW DIAGRAM: a top rectangle and three downward arrows toward small circles. Blue smiles and actively adds a suggestion with a raised pencil and open hand. Other sheets have only simple nonverbal work diagrams.
The result is useful cooperation caused by pink listening, not continued domination with a kinder smile. Full neutral bodies, sensible chairs, table legs, natural knees/calves and ALL SIX FEET are visible and fully inside the painted lower scene. No additional characters, toys, awards, lengthy explanation or decorative clutter.

STYLE AND CHARACTER DESIGN
Use authentic moderate hand-painted layered watercolor on luminous textured white paper. Broad softly irregular overlapping translucent washes are visible inside heads, torsos, arms, hands and legs, as well as the scenery, with varied pigment density and subtle local pooling. Colors are warm and clear with restrained soft shading. Preserve a natural painterly finish, not flat/vector coloring, marker, uniform fine colored-pencil grain, glossy plastic/3D, repetitive embossed texture, heavy mottling or decorative splashes.
Every head is a PERFECT CIRCLE with equal width and height, an uninterrupted circular contour, no oval, chin, jaw, flattened lower arc, ears, hair or nose. Head joins shoulders directly WITHOUT A NECK. A soft darker crescent of the same local body hue beneath the head separates it from the upper torso without creating a neck segment.
All bodies have balanced medium adult proportions, neither plump/chibi nor spindly or excessively stretched. All genders use the same simple neutral structure: gently almost-parallel torso sides, natural unshaped pelvis, coherent limbs and naturally aligned legs. No breasts, tiny waist, waist notch, projected hips, separate buttock bulge or gendered contours. Fine short upper-outer eyelashes, where specified, are the principal female cue and must not change the eye design.
Eyes are modest small dark ovals with an optional TINY light glint INSIDE, never white sclera surrounding a pupil or large doll eyes. Simple eyebrows and small expressive mouths. No sharp flat pink circular cheek spots; blush is absent or only barely perceptible diffuse translucent watercolor.
Each openly visible hand has exactly THREE FINGERS PLUS ONE THUMB, with natural gripping or folded-finger occlusion allowed. Body contours use darker versions of the SAME LOCAL BODY COLOR, not black; facial details and Persian letters may be dark.
Full figures, feet and important objects stay within scene boundaries; natural furniture/boat/prop occlusion is allowed but no body part or object is cut by file or panel edges. Clear irregular watercolor boundaries, generous CLEAN WHITE PAPER outer margins, narrow white gutters, no heavy panel borders. Polished thoughtful adult-book art, warm, kind, quietly witty and family friendly.
All in-image writing is ONLY the short verbatim Persian text specified for that scene, with accurate connected letters and right-to-left direction. No English, extra captions, numbers, watermark or signature. The pictured actions communicate the idea without an explanatory moral caption.
